description: Bürgerinitiativen für und gegen Straßenbauprojekte in Deutschland is a dataset listed in Data Atlas of Civil Society, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Greenpeace e.V.. Selection of around 150 citizens' initiatives for and against road construction projects in Germany. Coverage: Greenpeace e.V.. The portal shows the English title as "Citizens' initiatives for and against road construction projects in Germany" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Greenpeace e.V.. Its keywords include lobbyismus, autobahn, google dorking, mobilität, straßenbau, zivilgesellschaft. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2025-08-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.dcat-ap.de/def/licenses/20210721#cc-by-nc/4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datenatlas-zg.
